blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX brought out the broom and swept aside Phoenix mercilessly with a 137-89 victory to secure a place in the semifinals of the PBA Governors’ Cup on Saturday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Robert Bolick put on an early barrage with 16 of his 23 points in the first quarter as the Road Warriors won their best-of-five quarterfinal series, 3-0, to become the first team to reach the semis. Bolick’s explosion was marred by three triples and three four-point shots to help propel NLEX to just its third semis appearance in franchise history while breaking a string of quarterfinal disappointments.
